core: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair
qualifier: NHEJ and HR/NHEJ pathway choice
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and repair pathway choice
rationale: All members concern detecting DSBs (ATM signalling, chromatin remodelling, ADP-ribosylation) and choosing/executing end joining versus HR, unlike confusables centred on BRCA1/BRCA2 defects, resection and HR strand exchange.

qualifier: raft-based signalling complex assembly
name: T cell immunological synapse and signalling complex assembly
rationale: Members cover synapse formation, T cell polarity, raft localization, CD28-Vav1, CORO1A-DEF6 and second messenger generation, distinct from confusables built on integrin-mediated leukocyte migration and chemotaxis.

core: Striated muscle sarcomere organization and contraction
qualifier: T-tubules and cardiomyocyte desmosomal junctions
name: Striated muscle sarcomere, T-tubule and desmosomal junction organization
rationale: Members span sarcomere filament assembly and contraction plus cardiomyocyte adhesion, desmosomes and T-tubules, which separate it from SRF/myogenesis, generic adhesion and costamere/DGC confusables.

qualifier: spindle assembly checkpoint regulation
name: Mitotic spindle assembly and spindle checkpoint regulation
rationale: Members concern mitotic spindle formation, PLK1 and MAD2/kinetochore checkpoint control, unlike confusables on meiosis, G2/M centrosome kinases, cohesion/condensation or spindle elongation.

qualifier: Th17 lineage commitment and IL-17 production
name: Th17 lineage commitment and interleukin-17 production and signalling
rationale: Every member is IL-17 production, IL-17 receptor signalling or Th17 commitment, distinct from Th1/IL-12, IL-1 family, IL-1 processing and antifungal C-type lectin confusables.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase activation and PKA activation
name: Adenylate cyclase cAMP production and PKA activation
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis (including forskolin response), GPCR-coupled cyclic nucleotide signalling and PKA activation, whereas confusables emphasise CREB phosphorylation or Gi-mediated adenylate cyclase inhibition.

qualifier: presynaptic dopamine synthesis, release and catecholamine reuptake
name: Presynaptic dopamine synthesis, release and catecholamine reuptake
rationale: Members concern dopamine biosynthesis, secretion, catecholamine/monoamine uptake and dopaminergic transmission, unlike confusables on norepinephrine transporter defects or postsynaptic dopamine receptor and drug-response signalling.

qualifier: malate-aspartate shuttle and sodium-coupled di/tricarboxylate transporters
name: Carboxylate organic anion transport and malate-aspartate shuttle
rationale: All members move TCA-cycle carboxylates or related organic anions (succinate, citrate, malate/aspartate, sialin substrates) across membranes, distinct from pyruvate/organic cation, glutamate metabolism and cationic amino acid transport confusables.

core: Inner ear sensory hair cell function
qualifier: vestibular gravity sensing and hair cell specification
name: Inner ear hair cell specification and vestibular balance sensing
rationale: Members cover gravity/balance sensing, otoliths, vestibular reflex, hair cell fate and efferent outer hair cell inhibition, unlike confusables on inner ear and sensory organ morphogenesis or cochlear sound transduction.

qualifier: BAX/BAK effector step and downstream apoptosome/SMAC
name: BAX/BAK outer membrane permeabilization to apoptosome caspase activation
rationale: Members run from BAX/BAK activation and MOMP/cytochrome c release to apoptosome caspase activation and SMAC-IAP release, whereas confusables centre on upstream BH3-only protein activation.

qualifier: melanin synthesis and UV/blue light response
name: Melanin synthesis and light-induced melanocyte pigmentation
rationale: Members concern melanin biosynthesis, MITF pigmentation genes, pigment granule localization, melanocyte proliferation and UV-A/blue light responses, unlike confusables on other MITF programmes or melanosome biogenesis and acidification.

qualifier: beta-common (IL-3, IL-5) and gamma-chain (IL-2, IL-7, IL-9) receptors
name: Beta-common and gamma-chain cytokine receptor signalling
rationale: Members are IL-3/IL-5 (beta-common) and IL-2/IL-7/IL-9 (gamma-chain) signalling plus G-CSF signal termination, distinguishing it from IL-2/STAT5 hallmark, IL-15/IL-21 NK and FLT3/STAT5 confusables.

qualifier: lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue organization
name: Chemokine-guided leukocyte chemotaxis, homing and lymphoid tissue organization
rationale: Members cover chemokine/CXCR4/S1P-driven chemotaxis of T, B, DC, NK and mast cells, lymphocyte homing and lymph node/MALT development, unlike confusables on integrin adhesion or CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte recruitment.

qualifier: membrane potential and calcium control via G protein and kainate receptors
name: Presynaptic membrane potential and calcium regulation of transmitter release
rationale: Members concern presynaptic depolarization, calcium channels, Gbeta-gamma/GIRK inhibition, kainate receptors and vesicle exocytosis, distinct from confusables on negative presynaptic modulation, nicotinic receptors or inhibitory synapse assembly.

qualifier: carnitine, choline and trimethylamine oxidation
name: Carnitine, choline and trimethylamine metabolism
rationale: Members cover carnitine synthesis/transport, choline catabolism and FMO3 trimethylamine oxidation, separating it from methionine/SAM, creatine/phospholipid and sulfur amino acid confusables.

core: Hormonal control of appetite and feeding
qualifier: glucagon and calcitonin-family peptide GPCR cAMP signalling
name: Appetite-regulating peptide hormones via glucagon and calcitonin-family GPCRs
rationale: Members combine feeding/appetite regulation, ghrelin, GH and prolactin secretion with glucagon, calcitonin/amylin/CGRP, relaxin and somatostatin GPCR cAMP signalling, unlike confusables using leptin/GH JAK-STAT or fatty acid receptors.

qualifier: nucleotide interconversion, NAD(P) and phosphocreatine
name: Nucleotide interconversion, NAD(P) and phosphocreatine energy-carrier homeostasis
rationale: Members cover NMP/NDP phosphorylation, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange, NAD/NADP salvage and transport, and phosphocreatine, unlike confusables on viral MOMP apoptosis or nucleoside/drug transport.

qualifier: sodium-calcium exchange and calcium sequestration
name: Cytosolic calcium homeostasis via sodium-calcium exchange and sequestration
rationale: Members concern lowering and buffering cytosolic calcium through Na/Ca exchangers and sequestration plus calcium/caffeine responses, unlike confusables on store-operated entry, ER release or cardiac excitation.

qualifier: oxidative phosphorylation control and oxidative-stress-induced apoptosis
name: Mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative-stress-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate respiration, electron transport, ATP synthesis and ROS, and hydrogen peroxide/hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis, unlike confusables on ferroptosis, nitrosative stress or calcium-linked muscle apoptosis.

qualifier: isocitrate dehydrogenase and linked mitochondrial ATP synthesis
name: TCA cycle, isocitrate dehydrogenase and mitochondrial ATP synthesis
rationale: Members are TCA intermediates (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate), IDH-linked NADPH and 2-hydroxyglutarate, complex II and ATP synthase, unlike confusables on 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes, PDH/CoA or carboxylate shuttles.

qualifier: N-/O-glycans, glycosphingolipids, nucleotide sugars and lysosomal turnover
name: N-/O-glycan, glycosphingolipid and nucleotide-sugar metabolism with lysosomal turnover
rationale: Nearly all members concern N-glycan processing, mucin O-glycans, sialylation/fucosylation, GPI, glycosphingolipids, nucleotide-sugar synthesis/transport and lysosomal glycan catabolism (a few outliers aside), unlike confusables on proteoglycan GAGs, DAG1 O-mannosylation or dolichol-linked precursor assembly.

qualifier: nicotinic and neuromuscular cholinergic transmission
name: Cholinergic and serotonergic receptor signalling, including nicotinic transmission
rationale: Members are muscarinic, nicotinic and serotonin receptor signalling plus acetylcholine synthesis/secretion, distinct from purinergic/PDE, tachykinin gut, and histamine/serotonin synthesis confusables.

qualifier: progenitor proliferation and collagen matrix production
name: Osteoblast-lineage proliferation, differentiation and collagen matrix production
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation, Wnt signalling, collagen and proteoglycan production, tendon and trabecular bone, unlike confusables on RUNX2/ossification, BMP/TGF-beta or mineralization.

qualifier: ATP/adenosine receptors with calcium mobilization
name: Purinergic ATP and adenosine signalling with calcium mobilization
rationale: Members cover ATP export and hydrolysis, P2Y and P1 receptors, and the downstream rise in cytosolic calcium and CAMKK-AMPK, unlike confusables on other lipid/amine GPCRs or K-ATP channels.

qualifier: regulation of alternative splicing
name: snRNP biogenesis and regulation of alternative splicing
rationale: Members concern snRNP assembly, cap hypermethylation and snRNA transport plus positive/negative splicing regulation, unlike confusables on core splice-site reactions, snRNA transcription, RNA decay or histone mRNA 3'-end processing.
